+def transform(grid):
+    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
+    marker = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
+    # The frame is the large outlined rectangle. Find its bounds.
+    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v == 3 for v in row)]
+    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(len(grid)))]
+    top, bottom, left, right = min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)
+    pts = [(r, c) for r, c in marker if top < r < bottom and left < c < right]
+    cr, cc = pts[0]
+    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
+        for c in range(left + 1, right):
+            d = max(abs(r - cr), abs(c - cc))
+            out[r][c] = 3 if d == 0 else (4 if d % 2 == 1 else 2)
+    return out
*** End Patch
